body: Greg, 2026-11-11 ~09:11Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1370): 'Bo termal na dl560 uruchamiany jest z sesji ssh z central...'. The DL560 TermAl host runs inside an SSH session opened from Central. CONSEQUENCE: any Central reboot or SSH drop ends the DL560 TermAl HOST, its runner sessions and their relay mail. CORRECTION (Fable2, 09:16Z, from Opus2 #5538): launcher runs that the runner started DETACHED (setsid) SURVIVE the host's death. combo51's FULL test-40da21d4 kept running and PASSED at 08:40:05Z, after the ~08:30Z host loss. Only its END mail and the wakes registered on Central were lost; they were recovered from the run's original results. So after such an outage: FIRST recover each run's state from its original run directory. Relaunch only a run that is really absent or dead, as the same input with a confirmed start (ENVIRONMENT classification, not a retry-to-green). Running the DL560 host detached from Central's SSH session (tmux/systemd) is Greg's configuration decision, not an agent's.
